Lâm Đồng là một tỉnh thành thuộc khu vực.en: Lin Tung is a municipality of the South West Plain Mountains, which is a plateau with an average elevation from 800 to 1,000 metres above sea level. Lin Tung's natural area is more than 9.72 km2. Lin Tung has relatively complex terrain with high hills, small valleys.

Theo như chỉ dẫn từ Google Map, quãng đư.en: According to instructions from Google Map, the distance from Hanoi to Lindong is relatively far. If you come from the Green Swords, Hanoi will travel to the center of Lin County you will have to travel the distance from 1.885 - 1,700 km (4.7 km). The distance or close road depends on each of the destinations to take the goods, deliver the exact ones on each of the trips.
Theo như chỉ dẫn từ Google Map, quãng đư.zh: 根据谷歌地图的指示,从河内到林东的距离相对较远. 如果来自绿剑军,河内将前往林县中心,必须从1.885-1700公里(4.7公里)的距离出发. 距离或近距离的公路取决于每个目的地是否携带货物,在每次旅行中运送准确的货物。

Thời gian di chuyển trên tuyến đường này.en: The time of travel on this route is around 30 hours in a row. However, to line up to the receiver's hands required through packing stages, classifications, lifts, so time will be disparity. It was time for the form of road transport, railway. If the cargo is sent by airway, it usually takes only a few hours or even a day.
Thời gian di chuyển trên tuyến đường này.zh: 本路线的行驶时间为连续30小时左右. 然而,通过包装阶段,分类,升降机,排到接收者的手中,因此时间将是差距的. 现在是道路运输、铁路形式的时候了。 如果货物是空运的,通常只需要几个小时甚至一天。
